Skills API Publish Rail

scripts/publish-skills.mjs packages OrchestKit's built skills (plugins/ork/skills/*/SKILL.md) for the Claude Platform Skills API (POST /v1/skills). This runs the exact same three checks the script runs — client-side, on real and synthetic cases — and shows the dry-run payload it would compose. Nothing here ever calls the network.

    Issue #3628.
    Rules mirror scripts/publish-skills.mjs: name ≤64 chars, lowercase+hyphens only;
    description ≤1024 chars and must state when to use the skill.
    Real numbers (105 scanned, 103 pass, 2 fail) are from
    node scripts/publish-skills.mjs against the actual built catalog on 2026-08-21 —
    the two real failures (glyph, release-sync) are selectable below.
    Dry-run is the default; a real upload needs --publish and
    ANTHROPIC_API_KEY. Publishing stays a separate channel from the
    CC plugin marketplace (docs/marketplace-submission.md), which this
    script does not change.
